youtube_description:
It's no longer news that focusing on diversity, equity, and inclusion (DEI) is beneficial for companies. But what now?

Gillian Tans, former CEO of Booking.com and founder of Diversity Hero, shared insights at Slush 2023 on how to go beyond mere discussion on the topic toward actionable implementation.

Listen to the full talk on the Slush YouTube channel.
